contexts.text: The (scapegoat) = the natural man not purified; and, as this swarms with cupidities and uncleannesses of every kind (the scapegoat) was sent out of the camp into a land of cutting-off and the wilderness, that he might carry off the iniquities and sins of all in that Church. The land of cutting off and the wilderness = Hell. The laying on of hands by Aaron upon his head and the confession of sins, represented communication and transference; for so is it done when man is purified or expiated from sins; for the sins are then remitted to Hell, and affections of good and truth are implanted in their place...
